title: Prōnōmina Persōnālia
subtitle: Ego, tū, is/ea/id per omnēs cāsūs — a prīma introductiō ad dēclīnātiōnem.
objectives: Dēclīnāre ego et tū (et plūrālia nōs, vōs) per omnēs cāsūs
Dēclīnāre is, ea, id, quod locum prōnōminis tertiae persōnae tenet
Recognōscere quod Latīna nūllum prōnōmen tertiae persōnae proprium habet
Ēligere formam cāsūs aptam prō contextū simplicī (subiectum, obiectum, possessiō)

content.intro: Prōnōmina sunt verba parva sed potentissima — 'ego', 'tū', 'is' pro nōminibus stant. Hodiē vidēbis quōmodo tōta fōrma mūtātur secundum officium in sententiā: hoc vocātur cāsus (case), et est fundāmentum tōtīus grammaticae Latīnae.
content.explanation: Anglicē, ūnum tantum prōnōmen 'you' variat parum (I/me, he/him). Latīnē, quinque cāsūs distinctī variās fōrmās habent: nōminātīvus (subiectum), genetīvus (possessiō, 'of'), datīvus (obiectum indirēctum, 'to/for'), accūsātīvus (obiectum dīrēctum), ablātīvus (variī ūsūs, saepe cum praepositiōne).

rules.heading: b) Tū / Vōs (Secunda Persōna)
rules.body:
CāsusSingulārisPlūrālis
Nōm.tūvōs
Gen.tuīvestrī / vestrum
Dat.tibivōbīs
Acc.tēvōs
Abl.tēvōbīs

Nota: nostrum/vestrum (genetīvus partitīvus, 'one of us') differt ab nostrī/vestrī (genetīvus obiectīvus, 'mindful of us'): ūnus nostrum ('one of us') contrā memor vestrī ('mindful of you all').

rules.heading: c) Is, Ea, Id (pro Tertiā Persōnā)
rules.body:
Latīna nūllum prōnōmen tertiae persōnae proprium habet (dīversē ab ego/tū): adhibet is, ea, id, quod prōpriē dēmōnstrātīvum est ('that/this one'), sed officium 'he/she/it' implet.

rules.heading: d) Ūsus Cāsuum: Prīma Aspectus
rules.body: Nōminātīvus: subiectum ('ego videō' — I see). Accūsātīvus: obiectum dīrēctum ('mē videt' — he sees me). Datīvus: obiectum indirēctum ('mihi dat' — he gives to me). Genetīvus: possessiō ('domus eius' — his/her house). Ablātīvus: saepe cum praepositiōne ('cum eō' — with him).

examples: Ego tē videō. — I see you.
Tū mihi librum dās. — You give me a book.
Is eam amat. — He loves her.
Domus eius magna est. — His/her house is big.
Nōbīscum venī! — Come with us! (cum + nōbīs → nōbīscum)
Ūnus nostrum semper tardus est. — One of us is always late.

commonMistakes.wrong: Discipulus putat Latīnam habēre prōnōmen tertiae persōnae proprium, sīcut Anglicum 'he/she/it'.
commonMistakes.right: Latīna adhibet is/ea/id (orīgināliter dēmōnstrātīvum) prō hōc officiō — nūllum prōnōmen distīnctum exsistit.
commonMistakes.why: Haec est differentia frequenter neglēcta inter Latīnam et linguās Rōmānicās/Anglicam.

commonMistakes.right: 'mēcum' (ūnum verbum) — praepositiō 'cum' post prōnōmina persōnālia (mē, tē, nōbīs, vōbīs, sē) suffīgitur.
commonMistakes.why: Hoc est mōs orthographicus classicus fīxus, sine exceptiōne prō hīs prōnōminibus.

exercises.title: Ēlige Cāsum Rectum
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum formā rectā prōnōminis.

items.prompt: ___ librum legō. (I read a book — nōminātīvus)
Magister ___ librum dat. (gives to me — datīvus)
Venī ___! (with us — ablātīvus, ūnum verbum cum 'cum')
Cāsus nōminātīvus fēminīnīnus singulāris prōnōminis 'is, ea, id' est:

items.explanation: eius sōlus est prō masc./fem./neut. singulārī genetīvō.
ea = they (nōm./acc. neut. pl. — sīcut multa neutra, eadem fōrma prō nōm. et acc.).

items.prompt: Cūr 'is, ea, id' officium prōnōminis tertiae persōnae implet, quamvis orīgināliter aliud sit?
options: Quia Latīna nūllum prōnōmen tertiae persōnae proprium habet
items.explanation: Is/ea/id est vērē dēmōnstrātīvum, sed suppleō locum 'he/she/it' propter absentiam prōnōminis proprii.

exercises.title: Iunge Prōnōmen cum Cāsū
exercises.instructions: Iunge quamque fōrmam cum suā dēscrīptiōne cāsūs et significātiōnis.

items.explanation: Quaeque fōrma prōnōminis cāsum ūnicum et officium proprium in sententiā portat.

summary: Ego/nōs et tū/vōs sunt vēra prōnōmina persōnālia, plēnē dēclīnāta: meī/mihi/mē/mē, tuī/tibi/tē/tē...
Is, ea, id supplet locum 'he/she/it': Latīna nūllum prōnōmen tertiae persōnae proprium habet.
Cāsūs quīnque: nōminātīvus (subiectum), genetīvus (possessiō), datīvus (obiectum indirēctum), accūsātīvus (obiectum dīrēctum), ablātīvus (variī ūsūs).
